correctness.rationale: Every essential open edge is periodically invariant under a homeomorphism, forcing any global Milnor target to intersect its compact closure. The edgewise monotone quadratic construction realizes any hitting closed set, with a null countable exception and positive-measure basins approaching each target boundary. Boundary continuity, loop gluing, minimality, and finite edge-interior replacement are proved in RESULT.md. Six finite graph instances and 903 exact-rational interval checks independently support local steps but do not prove infinite claims.
